name: Mahatma Gandhi
knownFor: Leading India's non-violent freedom movement
description: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi played a central role in India's independence movement through the principles of truth, non-violence and civil disobedience.

name: Bhagat Singh
knownFor: His contribution to India's revolutionary independence movement
description: Bhagat Singh became one of India's most remembered revolutionary figures through his courage, writings and resistance to British colonial rule.

name: Subhas Chandra Bose
knownFor: Leading the Indian National Army
description: Popularly known as Netaji, he organised the Indian National Army and advocated armed resistance against British rule.

name: Rani Lakshmibai
knownFor: Her leadership during the Revolt of 1857
description: The Queen of Jhansi became a symbol of resistance during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.

name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
knownFor: Integration of princely states into independent India
description: Independent India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister, remembered for his major role in national integration.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru
knownFor: Becoming India's first Prime Minister
description: A prominent leader of the independence movement who served as India's first Prime Minister from 1947 to 1964.

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
knownFor: Chairing the Constitution's Drafting Committee
description: A leading architect of the Indian Constitution who campaigned for social equality, education and the rights of disadvantaged communities.

name: Savitribai Phule
knownFor: Pioneering women's education in India
description: One of India's earliest modern women teachers, she worked to expand education for girls and marginalised communities.

name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
knownFor: India's missile and space programmes
description: Known as the Missile Man of India, he served as the country's 11th President and inspired generations through science and education.

name: C. V. Raman
knownFor: Discovering the Raman Effect
description: Indian physicist who received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on the scattering of light.

name: Jagadish Chandra Bose
knownFor: Research in radio waves and plant physiology
description: A pioneering scientist whose research contributed to radio science and the study of plant responses.

name: Homi J. Bhabha
knownFor: Founding India's modern nuclear research programme
description: A key figure in establishing India's atomic energy research institutions and scientific infrastructure.

name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
knownFor: Groundbreaking contributions to number theory
description: A remarkable mathematician whose work in number theory, infinite series and mathematical analysis influenced modern mathematics.

name: Aryabhata
knownFor: Aryabhatiya and early mathematical astronomy
description: An influential ancient Indian scholar known for important work in mathematics and astronomy, including approximations of pi.

name: Rabindranath Tagore
knownFor: Winning the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913
description: A celebrated Bengali writer and composer who became the first non-European Nobel laureate in Literature.

name: Munshi Premchand
knownFor: Realistic Hindi and Urdu literature
description: A major Indian literary figure whose stories and novels explored social inequality, rural life and human struggles.

name: Sarojini Naidu
knownFor: Her poetry and role in the independence movement
description: Known as the Nightingale of India, she was a prominent poet, political leader and advocate for women's rights.

name: R. K. Narayan
knownFor: Creating the fictional town of Malgudi
description: A renowned English-language Indian author whose works portrayed everyday life in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.

name: Amrita Pritam
knownFor: Her Punjabi poetry and novel Pinjar
description: A celebrated Punjabi writer whose emotionally powerful works explored love, identity, partition and women's experiences.

name: Lata Mangeshkar
knownFor: Her extraordinary contribution to Indian film music
description: One of India's most iconic playback singers, whose career spanned several decades and numerous Indian languages.

name: M. S. Subbulakshmi
knownFor: Her contribution to Indian classical music
description: An internationally respected Carnatic vocalist and the first musician to receive the Bharat Ratna.

name: Bhimsen Joshi
knownFor: His powerful khayal singing
description: A leading exponent of the Kirana gharana, celebrated for his expressive voice and contribution to Hindustani classical music.

name: Satyajit Ray
knownFor: The Apu Trilogy and Indian cinema
description: An internationally acclaimed filmmaker whose humanistic storytelling transformed Indian cinema.

name: M. F. Husain
knownFor: Modern Indian art and expressive paintings
description: A prominent modern Indian artist recognised for bold lines, vivid colours and distinctive figurative paintings.

name: Pandit Ravi Shankar
knownFor: Popularising Indian classical music internationally
description: An influential sitar virtuoso who introduced many international audiences to Hindustani classical music.

name: Major Dhyan Chand
knownFor: His extraordinary achievements in Olympic hockey
description: One of India's greatest hockey players, remembered for his exceptional ball control and contribution to India's Olympic success.

name: Sachin Tendulkar
knownFor: Scoring 100 international centuries
description: Widely regarded as one of cricket's greatest batters, he represented India internationally for more than two decades.

name: P. V. Sindhu
knownFor: Winning Olympic silver and bronze medals
description: An internationally successful Indian badminton player and one of the country's leading Olympic medallists.

name: Neeraj Chopra
knownFor: Winning India's first Olympic athletics gold medal
description: An Indian track-and-field athlete who won Olympic gold in javelin at Tokyo 2020 and silver at Paris 2024.

name: Mary Kom
knownFor: Multiple world boxing championship titles and Olympic bronze
description: A celebrated Indian boxer whose achievements made her an influential figure in Indian women's sport.
